meta.name: i-have-adhd
meta.description: Shape output for a reader with ADHD. Use this skill whenever responding to ANY user message including coding tasks, debugging, explanations, planning, and casual conversation. Output should lead with concrete next actions, number multi-step work, externalize state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, and make wins visible. Trigger even on casual messages and even when the user did not explicitly ask for brevity.

copy.tagline: 为 ADHD 读者调整输出格式，突出行动要点。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果读者容易分心，需要清晰、可执行的回复。
